source: Roles written in chat from the suite's design; not taken from the skill files.

skills.name: fs-reverse-engineering
skills.role: Router: runs the stage sequence, keeps the holdout values away from the other skills, and hands work between them.

skills.name: idx-universe
skills.role: Lists IDX companies by sub-industry and picks the ones a wave will model.

skills.name: data-sourcing
skills.role: Finds each company's filings and records where every document came from.

skills.name: fs-intake
skills.role: Loads XBRL facts into the dataset and ties them out against the statements.

skills.name: fs-normalize
skills.role: Maps reported concepts onto one set of lines so companies can be compared.

skills.name: fs-driver-decomposition
skills.role: Splits reported lines into operating drivers using the company's archetype.

skills.name: peer-benchmark
skills.role: Builds sub-industry ranges for each driver from two or more companies.

skills.name: financial-modeling
skills.role: Builds the calibrated historical model and its forward mode.

skills.name: review-manager
skills.role: Runs the three gates and raises issues or escalations to the owner.

skills.name: guruh
skills.role: Logs errors across runs and proposes methodology changes between waves.
